claim_boundary: The quantified statement covers every complex polynomial of degree 32, but only classifies the threshold q(P,dx)<=3.
For a polynomial outside the three families, the conclusion is q(P,dx)>=4; its exact higher rank is not classified.
The result is a finite computer-assisted theorem candidate over Q-defined universal confinement ideals, not a proof-assistant object.
It does not prove the all-degree coefficient atlas.
Within-programme ordinary and optimized replay is not external independent reproduction.

coverage.support_rule: every subset S of {1,...,31} with 1 in S and |S|<=3

theorem_target.normalisation: monic and centred in the source, with an additive target constant suppressed
theorem_target.rank_three_prediction: No degree-32 polynomial has exact fixed-seed cyclic rank 3.
theorem_target.statement: For every P in C[x] of degree 32, q(P,dx)<=3 if and only if P is affine-equivalent to x^32, D_32(x,a) with a nonzero, or x^32+A*x^16 with A nonzero.
